[element-boxed-text]
=== `<boxed-text>` Boxed Text

Textual material that is part of the body of a standards document but is outside the flow of the narrative text (for example, a sidebar).

#### Usage/Remarks
The <<element-boxed-text,`<boxed-text>`>> element can be used for any text insert whether enclosed in a box or not (for example, marginalia, sidebars, cautions, tips, warnings, note boxes).
##### When Content is a Form

Two attributes are available to describe the boxed-text when it contains a form:
* <<attribute-is-form,`@is-form`>> can indicate that the text box contains a form.  What constitutes a “form” is not
                     defined by NISO STS.
* <<attribute-form-type,`@form-type`>> can identify the type of the form. If the form is not one of the listed types, <<attribute-custom-type,`@custom-type`>> may provide the type (see below).
##### Custom Form Type (<<attribute-custom-type,`@custom-type`>>)

<<attribute-form-type,`@form-type`>> has as its values a fixed list of form types. If your form is not one of the listed types, you can use <<attribute-custom-type,`@custom-type`>> to describe the form type. Set the value of <<attribute-form-type,`@form-type`>> to “`custom`” and also use <<attribute-custom-type,`@custom-type`>> to hold any form type you require. For example:
[source,xml]
....
<boxed-text is-form="form" form-type="custom" 
    custom-type="template">...</boxed-text>
....

#### Tagged Sample

##### Excerpt of MIL-STD-967 showing use of boxed text to illustrate two alternative notes
image::images/boxed-text-from-MIL-STD-967.png[boxed-text-from-MIL-STD-967.png]
[source,xml]
....
...
<p>... without updating the existing inactive for new design 
 notice.  When an inactive for new design document is revised 
 or a change issued, one of the following notes shall appear 
 in a box beneath the document title, as applicable:
 <boxed-text>
  <p>This document is inactive for new design.</p>
 </boxed-text>
 <boxed-text>
  <p>This document is inactive for new design. Refer to 
   (fill in document identifier) for new designs.</p>
 </boxed-text>
</p>
...
....
